# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Paladin level 3 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Paladin
# level-1/level-2 hybrid chassis baseline to level 3 as chosen input only. It
# names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity values.
# It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and
# bonus-feat) and the deterministic Longsword / Chain Shirt / no-shield /
# Power Attack posture from the level-1/level-2 fixtures, adding the level
# bump plus a new choice=choice:paladin_mercy selection this bounded tranche
# needs: PF1 Core Rulebook Mercy is a 3rd-level paladin class feature (the
# paladin selects one mercy from a fixed list; the first, 3rd-level tier is
# Fatigued, Shaken, and Sickened, verified against legacy.aonprd.com's Core
# Rulebook Paladin page: "At 3rd level, and every three levels thereafter, a
# paladin can select one mercy. Each mercy adds an effect to the paladin's lay
# on hands ability."). This fixture picks Shaken -- an arbitrary but
# deterministic pick among the three legal 3rd-level mercies, mirroring the
# Ranger Favored Terrain / Sorcerer bloodline-class-skill choice-slot-addition
# idiom.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later hybrid burden surface: no spell
# selections, no spells known/prepared posture, no domains, no mercy EFFECT
# resolution (curing the chosen condition when lay on hands is used -- no
# lay-on-hands execution engine exists in this codebase), no alignment-target
# or healing-resource accounting.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-paladin-level3
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:paladin:3
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:12
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:10
ability=charisma:14
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:diplomacy:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
choice=choice:paladin_mercy:mercy:shaken
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
